mapping_contract: For every present changes[] entry, original workspace path is changes[].path and exact retained path is this record bundle directory joined with before.snapshot. For absent entries no historical bytes are claimed. artifacts[].source_path identifies mechanical record-local staging, not implementation ownership.
rationale: Exact allowlisted working-tree baseline before integrated app and root deployment changes, including current public source helpers and explicit absent new paths.

reversion.plan: Separate authorized restoration must map changes[].path to this bundle changes[].before.snapshot; restore present bytes and verify sha256, reconcile formerly absent paths without deleting user work, then run exact owner checks. Constitution restoration is overseer-owned. No live restore or deletion performed.

snapshot_policy.input_scan: Explicit names only; no recursive repository scan. Secret-shaped paths refused except explicitly reviewed empty/example .env.example.
